description: Per-example absolute discrepancy between the sum of CIF firing weights and the target label count, reduced across the batch. Follows the quantity-loss equation in CIF paper §3.2 (paper.txt:177-181; implementation in src/topologies/implementations/losses/cif_quantity.py).

examples.title: Train a CIF predictor with quantity loss

name: CIF Quantity Loss

parameters.additional parameters: unsupported; unrecognized keyword parameters raise ValueError
parameters.ignore_index: must be None because the quantity equation has no token-level masking
parameters.logits_or_prediction: floating-point CIF firing weights shaped [B, U] with positive B and U
parameters.reduction: none returns one absolute discrepancy per example; mean averages examples; sum totals examples (default mean)
parameters.targets: real numeric target label counts shaped [B] on the prediction device
